topic.title: Market Structure: Higher Highs, Lower Lows, and Real Direction

research.summary: A sequence of higher highs and higher lows can describe upward structure. Lower highs and lower lows can describe downward structure. One swing alone does not define the whole market, and structure can change. Mark the swings, zoom out for context, and wait for confirmation instead of forcing a label.
